summary: Group B (Twilio SMS) end-to-end testing complete. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests PASS in test_group_b_sms.py — /api/twilio/status returns {configured:false, has_account_sid:true, has_auth_token:false, has_from_number:false} for owner; /api/twilio/test returns 400 'SMS not configured...' for owner and 403 for cleaner; POST /api/jobs with client_phone persists the field (verified via GET); enroute and complete endpoints BOTH return 200 for the assigned cleaner while SMS is unconfigured (send_sms no-ops as 'SEND BLOCKED' — confirmed in backend log); enroute still 403 for non-assigned cleaner. Frontend: dashboard for owner shows all 4 cards (booking-form-card, checklist-templates-card, clients-card, sms-settings-card) without errors; /sms-settings renders the status checklist (Account SID ✓ checked, Auth Token / From phone number ○ unchecked), 'What gets texted' section (3 bullets), Send Test form; tapping Send Test SMS with '+15551234567' displays the inline red error 'SMS not configured. Add TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN and TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER to the backend .env.' and the app does NOT crash; /post-job form shows the 'Client Phone (for SMS updates)' input with testID=job-client-phone. No new bugs found. SMS delivery intentionally MOCKED (SEND BLOCKED) — no real texts attempted, as expected.
action_items: None for Group B. SMS is behind config and degrades gracefully as designed. When the user provisions a Twilio phone number and sets TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN + TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER in /app/backend/.env, restart backend (sudo supervisorctl restart backend) — /api/twilio/status will flip to configured=true and enroute/complete will emit real SMS.
critical_code_review_comments: sms_configured() correctly guards send_sms — early return with 'SEND BLOCKED' logs (server.py:74-79) means missing Twilio creds never raise. Verified in backend log during test run.
/api/twilio/test raises HTTPException(400) with an explicit detail string when reason=='not_configured' (server.py:1865) — matches what /sms-settings displays inline.

JobIn model at server.py:332 declares client_phone: Optional[str] and it is stored on the job doc (create_job persists the full dict). GET /api/jobs/{id} returns it back — persistence verified in test_create_job_with_client_phone.

enroute_job (server.py:1597) and complete_job (server.py:997) both call send_sms only after checking job.get('client_phone'); send_sms itself is safe when creds missing. No exception path leaks to the response.
/sms-settings screen catches api.post errors and displays e.message inline (sms-settings.tsx:28-30) — does not surface a red-box error.

success_rate.frontend: All Group B testIDs render and behave as spec'd (sms-settings-card, sms-test-to, sms-test-send, job-client-phone). Inline error path verified. No crashes.

seed_data_creation: Test jobs prefixed TEST_ (TEST_SMS_JOB_*, TEST_SMS_FLOW_*, TEST_SMS_NOASSIGN_*) are deleted in owner_ctx teardown via DELETE /api/jobs/{id}. Group B does not touch cleaner profile docs.
